writePrerequisites: Fresh account/region, ETag, alias/config revision, pool/client/role/boundary receipts
Approved logging-v2 field exclusion and log-prefix CloudFront denial verified before any OAuth/session traffic
Guard code/invoke/read policies verified before any public client creation
Actual Add-only CREATE change sets and bounded phase UPDATE diffs reviewed
Existing pre-provisioned verified Advanced acceptance account only
prohibited: Production user creation/deletion or entitlement edits
Project writes, autosave or recovery-sync in test browser
S3 destructive sync or original index overwrite
Monitoring outside exactly two alarms and one owner-authorized email subscription

pilot.continuePolicyRequires: Named operator, owner-authorized confirmed mailbox, actual alarm-to-email delivery and acknowledgement, rollback access and accepted response commitment
rollbackImmediatelyOn: Registration regression or guard read/invoke failure
Wrong identity, privilege, issuer/audience or cookie host scope
Unreviewed infrastructure drift, replacement or cost expansion
pilot.automatedRollback: Required attended local supervisor; deterministic critical gate failure/timeout triggers prevalidated restoration; metric alarm alone is not a critical gate because expected guard denials increment Errors.

mandatoryPrivacyPrerequisite.preserve: Existing JSON format, source, destination and S3 suffix
mandatoryPrivacyPrerequisite.verification: Create one non-sensitive owned probe in AWSLogs/engent-release-a-probe/, verify its marker cannot be fetched through CloudFront, then delete only its recorded VersionId. No existing logs read.

monitoring.subscription: one owner-designated email; not yet provided/authorized
monitoring.topicPolicyPatch: append topic-policy-append.json only; preserve existing statements
monitoring.operator: owner must explicitly designate; no silent assignment
monitoring.responseProposal: acknowledge within 30 minutes during explicitly accepted coverage; unknown identity/privilege/data-write or confirmed registration outage triggers shared-auth rollback; no Codex background/on-call promise
monitoring.limits: No synthetic availability/semantic-security detector or 24x7 SLA. Expected denials can alert; confirm classification and acceptable noise before continuing.
